user_saw: In the sidebar or chat header, the Assign to submenu could stay open and keep its highlight after the pointer moved onto Fork conversation.
summary: The fix disables pointer hit testing on Web Awesome’s submenu hover triangle so neighboring rows can receive hover events.
reasoning: The fix’s Chromium reproduction shows that the hover triangle intercepted pointer movement from a tall assignee submenu to a sibling row. The Web Awesome safe-triangle logic predates the switch to the full user directory in #136978, but the earlier assignment menu could also render long lists. The diffs and tests I checked do not establish when this pointer path first failed.
